title: Medical Receptionist - Front Desk (Full-Time)
text:
Lakeview Family Medicine - Cedar Rapids, IA

About Us
Lakeview Family Medicine is a busy, physician-owned primary care practice serving families in the Cedar Rapids area for over 20 years. Our front desk team is the first impression patients have of our clinic, and we take that seriously.

Position Summary
We are seeking a friendly, organized Medical Receptionist to join our front office team. You will greet patients, answer a high volume of phone calls, schedule appointments, verify insurance eligibility, collect copays, and support our providers and clinical staff with day-to-day administrative tasks.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:45 AM - 5:00 PM. No weekends or holidays.

Responsibilities
- Greet and check in patients, verifying demographic and insurance information at every visit
- Answer multi-line phones, route calls, and take accurate messages
- Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments in our EHR (we use Athenahealth)
- Verify insurance eligibility and obtain referrals/authorizations as needed
- Collect copays and outstanding balances; balance the cash drawer daily
- Scan and index incoming records, faxes, and correspondence
- Maintain a clean, welcoming reception area

Requirements
- High school diploma or GED required
- Minimum 1 year of front desk or customer service experience; medical office experience strongly preferred
- Familiarity with insurance verification and medical terminology a plus
- Comfortable with computers and able to learn our EHR quickly
- Excellent phone etiquette and a genuinely warm demeanor with patients, including those who are anxious or upset
- Reliable attendance is essential - our patients and providers count on you

Compensation & Benefits
- $16.50 - $19.00 per hour, depending on experience
- Health, dental, and vision insurance after 60 days
- 401(k) with 3% match
- PTO accrual starting day one; 6 paid holidays

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Lakeview Family Medicine is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

To apply, submit your resume and a brief cover letter through our careers page. No phone calls, please.

title: Registered Nurse (RN) - Med/Surg, Night Shift
text:
St. Bartholomew Regional Medical Center - Dayton, OH
Department: Medical/Surgical Unit (4 East)
Status: Full-time, 36 hours/week, 7:00 PM - 7:30 AM, rotating weekends
$10,000 sign-on bonus for external candidates with a 2-year commitment

Why St. Bart's?
St. Bartholomew Regional is a 320-bed community hospital and a five-time recipient of the state's Nursing Excellence Award. Our 4 East unit cares for a diverse adult population including post-surgical, telemetry-monitored, and complex medical patients. Nurse-to-patient ratios average 1:5 on nights, with dedicated charge nurse and PCT support on every shift.

What You'll Do
- Deliver safe, compassionate, evidence-based nursing care to assigned patients
- Perform comprehensive assessments and develop individualized plans of care
- Administer medications and treatments per physician orders and hospital policy
- Monitor telemetry and respond to changes in patient condition; escalate appropriately
- Document accurately and timely in Epic
- Educate patients and families on diagnoses, medications, and discharge planning
- Precept new graduate nurses as assigned (after 1 year on unit)

What You'll Need
- Current, unencumbered RN license in the State of Ohio (or compact state license with ability to obtain Ohio licensure prior to start)
- Graduate of an accredited school of nursing; ADN accepted, BSN preferred (BSN required within 4 years of hire per our Magnet journey commitment)
- Minimum 1 year of acute care RN experience required for night shift; new grads are encouraged to apply to our RN Residency posting instead
- BLS certification (American Heart Association) required at hire; ACLS required within 6 months
- Telemetry experience strongly preferred

Compensation
$34.20 - $48.75/hour based on experience, plus $4.50/hour night differential and $2.25/hour weekend differential. Full benefits package including medical/dental/vision, 403(b) with match, tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year, and free on-site parking.

All offers are contingent on a pre-employment drug screen, background check, and verification of licensure and immunization status.

St. Bartholomew Regional Medical Center is an EEO/AA employer. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to sponsor visas for this position at this time.

title: Medical Biller / Revenue Cycle Specialist
text:
Summit Orthopedics & Sports Medicine - Remote (must reside in AZ, NV, or UT)

Summit Orthopedics is a 14-provider specialty group with clinics across the Phoenix metro area. Our central business office is growing, and we're adding an experienced Medical Biller to our revenue cycle team. This is a remote position, but candidates must reside in Arizona, Nevada, or Utah and be available for quarterly on-site team meetings in Tempe.

What you'll own
- Charge entry and claim submission (professional claims, CMS-1500) for orthopedic surgery, PM&R, and physical therapy services
- Working denials and rejections; drafting and submitting appeals with supporting documentation
- Payment posting and reconciliation of ERAs/EOBs
- A/R follow-up on aging accounts across commercial payers, Medicare, Medicaid/AHCCCS, and workers' comp
- Responding to patient billing questions with patience and clarity
- Flagging coding or documentation issues to our certified coders

What we're looking for
- 2+ years of hands-on medical billing experience, orthopedics or surgical specialty strongly preferred
- Solid working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifier usage (especially 25, 59, and laterality modifiers)
- Experience with payer portals (Availity, UHC, Noridian) and clearinghouse workflows
- CPB or CPC certification through AAPC is a plus, not required
- Experience with athenaCollector or similar practice management systems
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Self-directed and productive in a remote environment - we track quality and throughput, not keystrokes

Pay and benefits
$21 - $26/hour DOE. Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with 4% match, 15 days PTO plus holidays, and a $500 home office stipend. Equipment provided.

A background check is required prior to start due to access to protected health information.

Interested? Send your resume to careers@summitorthoaz.example.com with "Medical Biller" in the subject line.

title: Certified Pharmacy Technician - Inpatient Pharmacy
text:
Meriwether County Hospital - Rockmart, GA
Inpatient Pharmacy | Full-Time | Rotating shifts (day/evening), every third weekend

Job Summary
Under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist, the Pharmacy Technician assists in the preparation, distribution, and inventory control of medications for our 96-bed acute care hospital. This role supports unit-dose dispensing, IV admixture preparation in our USP 797-compliant cleanroom, automated dispensing cabinet (Pyxis) replenishment, and controlled substance auditing.

Essential Duties
- Prepare and label unit-dose medications and sterile IV admixtures under pharmacist verification
- Restock Pyxis MedStations throughout the facility and resolve discrepancies
- Perform monthly nursing unit inspections and expiration date checks
- Receive, stock, and rotate pharmacy inventory; process returns and recalls
- Maintain perpetual inventory for controlled substances and assist with DEA-required documentation
- Answer phones and triage requests to the appropriate pharmacist

Minimum Qualifications
- High school diploma or GED
- Current registration as a Pharmacy Technician with the Georgia Board of Pharmacy in good standing - required prior to first day of work
- National certification (PTCB or ExCPT) required, or must be obtained within 12 months of hire
- Prior hospital pharmacy experience preferred; strong retail technicians willing to learn sterile compounding will be considered
- Ability to stand for extended periods and lift up to 40 lbs
- Attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role

Preferred
- Sterile compounding experience and current USP 797/800 training
- Experience with Epic Willow and Pyxis

What We Offer
Competitive hourly pay commensurate with experience, shift differentials, comprehensive benefits, retirement plan with employer contribution, and paid certification renewal fees.

Conditions of Employment
All positions at Meriwether County Hospital require a criminal background check, drug screening, and proof of required immunizations (including annual influenza vaccination) prior to start. 

Meriwether County Hospital is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

title: Care Coordinator - Population Health (Bilingual Preferred)
text:
Harborline Community Health Centers - Everett, WA (hybrid: 3 days on-site, 2 remote after 90 days)
Salary range: $58,000 - $70,000 annually, plus $2,000/year bilingual differential for Spanish or Vietnamese fluency

Who we are
Harborline is a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) serving 42,000 patients across five clinic sites in Snohomish County. Our Population Health team helps patients with chronic conditions and complex social needs navigate the health care system and actually get to the care they need.

About the role
The Care Coordinator manages a panel of roughly 120 high-risk patients - primarily adults with poorly controlled diabetes, CHF, COPD, and co-occurring behavioral health needs. You will be the connective tissue between patients, primary care teams, specialists, hospitals, and community resources.

A typical week includes
- Outreach calls and warm handoffs following hospital discharges and ED visits (we receive daily ADT feeds)
- Developing patient-centered care plans with the patient, their PCP, and our RN care managers
- Screening for social determinants of health and connecting patients to housing, food, transportation, and insurance enrollment resources
- Coordinating referrals, prior authorizations, and specialist follow-up; closing care gaps for HEDIS quality measures
- Documenting all activity in Epic and our care management platform
- Occasional home visits and accompaniment to appointments (agency vehicle available)

Minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in social work, public health, nursing, or a related human services field required; relevant experience may substitute on a year-for-year basis for up to two years of the degree requirement
- At least 2 years of experience in care coordination, case management, community health work, or a similar patient-facing role
- Valid Washington State driver's license and reliable transportation (mileage reimbursed at the federal rate)
- Strong working knowledge of Medicaid (Apple Health) and Medicare
- Cultural humility and demonstrated success working with diverse, underserved populations

Preferred
- Bilingual Spanish/English or Vietnamese/English
- CHW certification or case management certification (CCM)
- Experience in an FQHC or managed care setting

Benefits
Medical/dental/vision (Harborline pays 90% of employee premium), 5% 403(b) match, 22 days PTO, 10 holidays, and NHSC loan repayment site eligibility.

Offers are contingent on completion of a criminal background check as required by Washington State for positions with unsupervised access to vulnerable adults.

Harborline Community Health Centers is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage candidates from the communities we serve to apply.

title: Senior Content Designer, Payments Experience
text:
About the role

Ledgerline is building the financial back office for 40,000+ small businesses, and words are a core part of our product surface. We're hiring a Senior Content Designer to own end-to-end content for our Payments and Invoicing squads — everything from onboarding flows and empty states to error messages and transactional email.

You'll be the second content designer on a 45-person product design team, so you'll shape not just the words but the practice: voice and tone guidelines, terminology standards, and how content design plugs into our design system (we work in Figma with a shared component library, and document patterns in Confluence and Notion).

What you'll do
- Partner with product designers, PMs, and engineers from discovery through ship on 2-3 workstreams at a time
- Write and iterate on UI copy directly in Figma files; maintain our content style guide
- Run content crits and lightweight comprehension testing with our research team (we use Maze and UserTesting)
- Audit and rationalize product terminology across web and mobile — right now three teams call the same object three different things, and it shows
- Work with localization vendors to make sure source strings translate cleanly into our 6 supported languages

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of content design, UX writing, or equivalent product content experience, with at least 2 years on a shipped B2B or fintech product
- A portfolio is required — we want to see 2-3 case studies showing your process, the constraints you worked within, and measurable outcomes. Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.
- Fluency working in Figma alongside designers; comfort reading basic product analytics (we use Amplitude)
- Experience writing for regulated or high-stakes domains (payments, healthcare, insurance) is a strong plus
- Bonus: familiarity with content management in a string-management tool like Lokalise or Phrase

Logistics
This is a hybrid role based out of our Toronto office — we're in the office Tuesday through Thursday. We are not able to consider fully remote candidates for this position at this time.

Compensation is CAD $135,000–$160,000 base plus equity and benefits, depending on experience.

Ledgerline is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, and we're happy to make accommodations throughout the interview process.

title: UX Writer II — Growth Team
text:
Parcelo (remote, US)

Parcelo helps 12M people track every package they've ever ordered in one place. Our Growth team owns the first-run experience, notifications, and the free-to-paid upgrade journey — and every one of those surfaces lives or dies on the words. We're looking for a UX Writer II to join a pod of 2 designers, 4 engineers, and a PM.

The work
- Write, test, and ship copy for onboarding, push notifications, paywalls, and lifecycle email
- Run A/B tests on copy variants with our experimentation platform; you should be comfortable forming a hypothesis, reading results, and knowing when a 0.4% lift is noise
- Keep our voice consistent as we scale — you'll co-own the voice & tone doc with our brand team and push back when "just make it punchier" isn't the answer
- Work in Figma daily; annotate flows, maintain copy components, leave better comments than you found
- Document decisions and patterns in Confluence so the next writer (or future you) isn't archaeologizing Slack threads

About you
- 3+ years writing for digital products, ideally consumer mobile
- You've shipped copy that moved a metric and can talk about what you learned when it didn't
- You write clean, short, human sentences and you can defend every word in a crit
- Experience with experimentation tools (Optimizely, Statsig, or homegrown) and basic SQL is a plus, not a requirement

How to apply
Send a resume and 3-5 writing samples (screenshots of shipped UI are perfect — no need for a polished portfolio site). In your application, please include your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. Candidates who advance will complete a short paid writing exercise (2 hours, compensated at $150).

Parcelo is fully remote within the United States. We offer health/dental/vision, a $500 home office stipend, and a 4-day workweek every other week during summer.

title: Knowledge Manager, Customer Support Operations
text:
About Vantyx

Vantyx provides identity verification APIs to 900+ companies, and our 120-person global support org answers roughly 40,000 tickets a month. The single biggest lever on our resolution time isn't headcount — it's the quality of our knowledge base. That's where you come in.

We're hiring a Knowledge Manager to own our internal and external knowledge programs end to end. Today that means a Zendesk Guide help center with ~600 public articles, an internal Confluence space that has grown organically (read: chaotically) to 3,000+ pages, and a Guru instance for agent-facing snippets. Your job is to turn this sprawl into a system.

Responsibilities
- Own the knowledge lifecycle: intake, authoring standards, review cadences, archival. Implement KCS (Knowledge-Centered Service) practices across the support org — KCS v6 certification is a plus
- Audit and restructure our Confluence information architecture; define templates, labels, and governance so content stays findable and fresh
- Partner with our AI team feeding the KB into our support chatbot and agent-assist tooling — article structure directly affects deflection rates, and you'll own that quality bar
- Build dashboards on article performance (views, deflection, agent feedback) and report monthly to support leadership
- Train and coach 15+ contributing authors across three time zones; you're an editor and an evangelist, not just a librarian
- Run quarterly content audits and kill stale pages without mercy

Requirements
- 4+ years in knowledge management, technical content, or support enablement, with at least 2 years administering a knowledge platform (Confluence, Zendesk Guide, Guru, or similar) at scale
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience with information architecture and taxonomy design
- Strong writing and editing skills — you'll be asked to edit a sample article during the interview process
- Familiarity with support metrics (deflection, FCR, CSAT) and how knowledge programs move them

Nice to have
- Experience preparing knowledge bases for retrieval-augmented AI systems
- Basic HTML/CSS and comfort with API-driven content migrations

Location and compensation
Remote-first; we hire in the US, UK, and Ireland. US base salary range: $95,000–$125,000 plus bonus. This role requires successful completion of a background check due to the sensitive nature of the data our customers trust us with.

title: Conversation Designer — Voice & Chat AI
text:
Norwave | Seattle, WA (hybrid) or Remote (US)

Norwave builds the customer-facing AI layer for regional banks and credit unions. Our virtual agents handle 2M+ conversations a month across chat, SMS, and voice IVR — and we're moving fast from intent-based flows to LLM-driven experiences with guardrails. We need a Conversation Designer who can work across both worlds.

What you'll own
- Design end-to-end conversation flows for banking use cases: balance inquiries, disputes, card replacement, fraud alerts. These are high-stakes moments; empathy and precision both matter
- Write and maintain prompts, persona guidelines, and fallback strategies for our LLM-based agents; design the escape hatches to human agents so nobody gets trapped in a loop
- Build and iterate in our conversation design tooling (we use Voiceflow for prototyping and an internal orchestration platform in production; past experience with Dialogflow CX, Rasa, or Kore.ai translates well)
- Partner with NLU engineers on intent taxonomies, entity design, and utterance data; run error analysis on transcripts weekly and turn findings into design changes
- Define and track conversation quality metrics: containment, task completion, CSAT, and escalation reasons
- Adapt flows for voice — you understand that what works in a chat bubble dies in an IVR, and you can write for the ear (SSML experience a plus)

What we're looking for
- 3+ years designing conversational experiences (chatbots, voice assistants, or IVR modernization) with at least one product live in production at meaningful scale
- Writing samples or sample dialogs will be requested during the process
- Working knowledge of how NLU and LLM systems actually behave — you don't need to code, but you should be able to read a confusion matrix and reason about hallucination risk
- Experience in a regulated industry (banking, insurance, healthcare) preferred
- Familiarity with Figma and FigJam for flow mapping and stakeholder walkthroughs

Please note: applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas (including H-1B, TN, or OPT/STEM extensions) for this role now or in the future.

Base salary: $120,000–$155,000 depending on level and location, plus equity. Seattle-based employees come in Tuesdays and Wednesdays; remote employees fly in quarterly for design sprints (travel covered).

title: Technical Writer, Developer Documentation
text:
About the team

Stackform's API platform processes infrastructure-as-code deployments for 8,000 engineering teams. Developers' first real experience of our product is our docs — and right now our docs team is two writers supporting 60 engineers shipping weekly. We're adding a third.

What you'll work on
- Own documentation for our REST and Terraform provider surfaces: API reference, quickstarts, migration guides, and changelog
- Write docs-as-code: our site is built with Markdown/MDX in a Git monorepo, published via a static site generator, reviewed through pull requests like any other change. You should be comfortable with Git branching, code review etiquette, and occasionally fixing your own build breaks
- Generate and maintain API reference from OpenAPI specs; wrangle the spec when engineering's annotations drift from reality
- Test every code sample you publish. We maintain runnable examples in Python, TypeScript, and Go — you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to run a script, read a stack trace, and tell an engineer precisely what's broken
- Interview engineers and PMs to extract the why behind features, then cut 80% of what they tell you
- Contribute to our style guide and docs information architecture; we document internal decisions in Confluence and track work in Jira/Linear

You might be a fit if
- You have 2+ years writing developer-facing documentation, or you're an engineer who discovered you like writing more than coding
- You've worked with OpenAPI/Swagger, Markdown toolchains, and static site generators (Docusaurus, Mintlify, Hugo, or similar)
- You can explain authentication flows to a junior developer without being wrong or boring
- Links to published documentation you've written will strengthen your application considerably

Details
- Full-time, remote within UTC-8 to UTC+2
- Salary band: $105,000–$140,000 USD (or local-market equivalent), reviewed annually
- Interview process: recruiter screen, portfolio/samples review, a take-home docs critique (90 minutes, paid), and a panel. No whiteboard hazing.

Stackform is a distributed company of 190 people across 14 countries. We're committed to an inclusive hiring process and welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

title: Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift (Full Time)
text:
Midland Distribution Services is hiring Warehouse Associates for our Romeoville, IL fulfillment center. We move fast, we promote from within, and we pay weekly.

Pay: $19.50/hr base + $1.50/hr shift differential for 2nd shift
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM. Mandatory overtime during peak season (Oct-Dec), including some Saturdays. You must be available to work weekends during peak.

What you'll do:
- Pick, pack, and stage orders using an RF scanner
- Load and unload trailers, sometimes in non-climate-controlled dock areas
- Operate pallet jacks; forklift certification a plus (we'll train and certify you on sit-down and reach trucks within 90 days)
- Perform cycle counts and keep your zone clean per 5S standards
- Meet daily productivity and accuracy targets

Physical requirements:
- Ability to lift up to 50 lbs repeatedly throughout a 8-10 hour shift
- Stand and walk for the majority of the shift (10,000+ steps/day is normal here)
- Bend, stoop, reach overhead, and climb stairs
- Work in temperatures ranging from 40°F on the dock to 90°F in summer months

Requirements:
- Must be at least 18 years old
- High school diploma or GED preferred but not required
- Reliable transportation - we are not on a bus line
- Able to pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check. We do not test for THC in Illinois, but we do test for everything else, and post-accident testing includes all substances.
- Previous warehouse, distribution, or manufacturing experience is helpful but not required. We hire for attitude and train for skill.

Benefits after 60 days: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with 4% match, PTO accrual from day one, $500 referral bonus, safety shoe reimbursement up to $110/year.

Midland Distribution Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Apply online or walk in Tuesday/Thursday 9 AM - 3 PM at 1480 Prologis Pkwy, Romeoville, IL 60446. Bring two forms of ID.

title: Shift Lead / Key Holder - Cedar Point Plaza
text:
About the role

Trailhead Outfitters (Cedar Point Plaza, Fort Collins, CO) is looking for a Shift Lead to help run daily store operations. This is a key holder position - you'll open and close the store, manage the register including till counts and bank deposits, and lead a team of 4-8 sales associates when the Store Manager is off.

What you'll own:
- Opening/closing procedures, alarm codes, and cash handling (tills, safe drops, deposit runs)
- Coaching associates on customer service and loss prevention basics
- Processing shipment, replenishing the floor, and executing planogram resets
- Handling customer escalations, returns, and price overrides
- POS troubleshooting and end-of-day reconciliation

Schedule: Retail hours are retail hours - we need genuine open availability including nights, weekends, and holidays. Shift Leads typically work 2-3 closing shifts per week and every other weekend at minimum. Blackout dates apply during the holiday season (no PTO Nov 20 - Dec 26).

What we need from you:
- 1+ year of retail experience required; 6+ months in a lead, keyholder, or supervisory role strongly preferred
- Comfortable being on your feet for full 8-hour shifts and lifting boxes up to 35 lbs when processing freight; use of ladders for topstock
- Basic math skills for cash handling - your drawer needs to balance
- Must be 18+ and able to pass a background check (required for key holder positions due to cash handling and alarm access)

Pay and perks: $18.00 - $20.50/hr depending on experience, plus monthly store bonus when we hit plan. 40% employee discount, pro-deals with our vendors, and paid sick leave per Colorado law. Full-timers (30+ hrs) get medical/dental after 90 days.

We're a dog-friendly store and most of us are out on the trails on our days off. If that sounds like your people, come say hi - drop a resume in store or apply through our careers page.

title: CDL Class A Driver - Regional, Home Weekends
text:
Kestrel Freight Lines - Regional CDL-A Driver (Southeast lanes)

We run dry van freight out of our Ellenwood, GA terminal covering GA, AL, TN, SC, and FL. Out 4-5 days, home most weekends. No NYC, no coast-to-coast, no forced dispatch on your home time.

Pay:
- $0.62 - $0.68 CPM based on verifiable experience, average 2,300-2,600 miles/week
- Most of our regional drivers gross $75,000 - $85,000/year
- $2,500 sign-on bonus paid out over 6 months
- Detention pay after 2 hours, layover pay, stop pay $25/stop after first

Equipment: 2022 or newer Freightliner Cascadias and Kenworth T680s, governed at 68, APUs, inverters, fridges. Automatics only. No slip-seating - you keep your truck.

Requirements - please read before applying:
- Valid Class A CDL
- Minimum 12 months of verifiable OTR or regional tractor-trailer experience within the last 3 years. We are not a training fleet and cannot accept recent CDL school graduates at this time.
- Must be at least 23 years of age (insurance requirement)
- No more than 3 moving violations in the past 3 years; no DUI/DWI in the past 7 years; no preventable DOT-recordable accidents in the past 3 years
- Must pass DOT physical and hold a current medical card
- Pre-employment DOT drug screen (urine) plus hair follicle test - if you can't pass both, don't waste your time or ours. We also run FMCSA Clearinghouse and PSP checks on every applicant.
- Able to occasionally handle tailgate deliveries; most freight is drop-and-hook or live unload no-touch
- Tanker endorsement a plus, not required. No hazmat freight.

Benefits: BCBS medical/dental/vision after 30 days, 401(k) with match after 90 days, paid vacation after 1 year, rider and pet policy from day one, $1,500 driver referral bonus.

Orientation is 2 days in Ellenwood, paid at $200/day with hotel covered. Call our recruiting line at (770) 555-0142 or apply online - we get back to every qualified driver within 24 hours.

title: Line Cook - Scratch Kitchen (Full Time, PM Shifts)
text:
The Copper Fig | Asheville, NC | Line Cook

We're a 120-seat scratch kitchen doing 300+ covers on a Saturday night. Everything is made in-house - stocks, sauces, pasta, butchery. We're looking for a line cook who wants to actually cook, not open bags.

The job:
- Work sauté and grill stations during service; cross-train on all stations including pantry and fry
- Daily prep from prep lists: knife work, sauces, proteins, mise en place for your station
- Follow recipes and plating specs consistently at volume
- Label, date, rotate (FIFO) and maintain temp logs - health department scores matter to us and we've held an A for six years
- Break down and deep-clean your station nightly

Schedule: This is a PM position, roughly 1 PM - 11 PM. We are closed Mondays. Weekend availability is non-negotiable - Friday and Saturday nights are our bread and butter and everyone works them. Expect 38-45 hours/week.

What we're looking for:
- 2+ years of line experience in a full-service, scratch-cooking kitchen. We will ask you to trail/stage a shift before we make an offer.
- Solid knife skills and a sense of urgency without sloppiness
- ServSafe Food Handler required within 30 days of hire (we reimburse the cost); ServSafe Manager certification a plus and comes with a pay bump
- Able to stand for 8-10 hours in a hot kitchen, lift 50 lb stock pots and sacks of flour, and work in walk-in coolers
- Show up on time, sober, in clean whites. That's the whole culture speech.

Pay: $17 - $21/hr based on experience, plus a tip-share that typically adds $2-4/hr. Shift meal every shift, 50% off when you dine here, health insurance contribution for full-time staff after 90 days, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

To apply: email your resume to the address on our website or drop it off Tuesday-Friday between 2 and 4 PM and ask for Chef Dana. Tell us the best thing you know how to cook.

title: HVAC Service Technician - Residential (Sign-On Bonus)
text:
Blue Summit Heating & Air - Residential HVAC Service Technician - Chandler, AZ

Family-owned since 2004, 22 trucks on the road, and booked out two weeks deep every summer. We need experienced service techs who can diagnose and fix - not just quote replacements.

What you'll do:
- Run 4-7 residential service calls per day: diagnostics, repairs, and maintenance on split systems, heat pumps, and package units (lots of rooftop package units here in the Valley)
- Brazing, refrigerant charging, capacitor/motor/board replacement, ductwork assessment
- Present findings and repair options honestly to homeowners - we pay performance bonuses on customer reviews, not on selling parts people don't need
- Document everything in ServiceTitan on a company iPad

Compensation:
- $28 - $38/hr depending on experience, plus performance bonuses (our senior techs cleared $95k last year)
- $3,000 sign-on bonus for techs with 3+ years of residential service experience, paid at 90 days and 6 months
- Take-home truck, gas card, iPad, uniforms, and annual boot allowance

Requirements:
- EPA 608 Universal certification required - no exceptions, you'll be handling refrigerant daily
- Minimum 2 years of residential HVAC service experience (not just install); NATE certification preferred and comes with an hourly premium
- Valid Arizona driver's license with a clean driving record (39-month MVR check) - you're driving a company truck
- Pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check; we work inside customers' homes and background-check every tech, no exceptions
- Physically able to lift 75 lbs, climb ladders to rooftops, work in attics that hit 140°F+ in summer, and crawl in tight crawl spaces
- On-call rotation: one week every 6 weeks during summer season (May-Sept), with on-call pay plus overtime for after-hours calls. Some Saturday shifts in peak season.

Benefits: medical/dental/vision (company pays 75% of employee premium), 401(k) with 3% match, 2 weeks PTO to start, 6 paid holidays, paid training and NATE certification reimbursement.

Apply online or text SUMMIT to the number on our website. Every application gets a response within 2 business days.

title: Staff Accountant
text:
Staff Accountant
Meridian Building Products | Columbus, OH (Hybrid - 3 days in office)

About Us
Meridian Building Products is a regional distributor of commercial construction materials serving contractors across Ohio, Indiana, and Kentucky. We've been family-owned for 40 years and run lean, which means our accounting team touches everything from AP to financial reporting.

The Role
We're adding a Staff Accountant to support our Controller through a period of growth. You'll own core month-end close activities and help us clean up processes as we migrate from QuickBooks to NetSuite later this year.

What You'll Do
- Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations as part of the monthly close (we close in 7 business days and want to get to 5)
- Maintain the general ledger and investigate variances flagged by the Controller
- Process fixed asset additions, disposals, and monthly depreciation
- Reconcile bank and credit card accounts weekly
- Assist with accounts payable during peak season (roughly 400 invoices/month)
- Support the annual review with our external CPA firm - pulling schedules, tying out balances
- Help document procedures as we move to NetSuite

What We Need
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance (required)
- 2+ years of general ledger accounting experience; distribution, construction, or manufacturing industry a plus
- Solid understanding of US GAAP, especially accruals and revenue recognition basics
- Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP - you'll use these daily)
- Experience with QuickBooks, NetSuite, or a similar ERP
- CPA or CPA candidate is nice to have, not required

Details
- Salary: $58,000 - $68,000 depending on experience
- Hybrid schedule: Tuesday-Thursday in our Grove City office, Monday/Friday remote after your first 90 days (fully in-office during training)
- Health, dental, vision; 401(k) with 4% match; 15 days PTO plus holidays

To apply, send a resume to careers@meridianbp.com with "Staff Accountant" in the subject line. No agencies, please.

title: HR Generalist
text:
HR Generalist - Manufacturing Site
Cascade Precision Components | Everett, WA (Onsite)

Cascade Precision Components machines aerospace-grade parts for commercial and defense customers. We employ about 240 people across two shifts, and this role is the primary HR presence on our production floor. This is a fully onsite position - our workforce is on the floor and so is our HR team.

What the job actually looks like
You'll be the first call for supervisors and hourly employees on everything people-related. Some days that's walking a new hire through benefits enrollment; other days it's an employee relations investigation or figuring out an FMLA leave that overlaps with a workers' comp claim. You'll report to the HR Manager and work alongside one HR Coordinator.

Responsibilities
- Run full-cycle recruiting for hourly production roles (machinists, quality inspectors, material handlers) - sourcing through offer
- Own onboarding and new hire orientation for both shifts
- Handle day-to-day employee relations: coaching supervisors, documenting performance issues, conducting investigations with the HR Manager
- Administer leaves of absence (FMLA, WA Paid Family & Medical Leave, ADA accommodations)
- Maintain employee records in ADP Workforce Now and ensure I-9 compliance
- Support open enrollment and answer benefits questions year-round
- Track and report safety training completion with our EHS lead

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or a related field, OR an associate degree plus 2 additional years of relevant experience
- Minimum 3 years of HR generalist experience; manufacturing, warehouse, or other hourly-workforce environment strongly preferred
- Working knowledge of federal and Washington state employment law (L&I, PFML, sick leave rules)
- Experience with an HRIS - we use ADP Workforce Now
- SHRM-CP or PHR a plus
- Ability to flex hours occasionally to cover second-shift needs (roughly once or twice a month)

Compensation and benefits
- $68,000 - $82,000/year depending on experience
- Medical/dental/vision (company pays 85% of employee premium), 401(k) with match, 3 weeks PTO
- Annual bonus target of 5%

Cascade Precision Components is an equal opportunity employer. Offers are contingent on a background check as required for our defense customer contracts.

title: Project Manager, Implementation Services
text:
Project Manager, Implementation Services
BrightPath Health Technologies | Nashville, TN (Hybrid)

BrightPath builds scheduling and patient-intake software used by 300+ specialty clinics nationwide. Our implementation team takes clinics from signed contract to go-live, and we're hiring a Project Manager to run 6-10 concurrent implementations of varying size.

What you'll own
- End-to-end delivery of customer implementations: kickoff, requirements gathering, configuration milestones, data migration coordination, training, and go-live
- Project plans, RAID logs, and status reporting in Jira and Smartsheet - our leadership reviews portfolio status weekly and expects clean data
- Scope and change management: when a clinic asks for something out of scope, you're the one who has the conversation and writes the change order
- Budget tracking against services hours sold; you'll flag margin risk to your director before it becomes a problem
- Cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Support, and third-party EHR vendors (Epic, athenahealth integrations are common)
- Running crisp stakeholder meetings with clinic administrators and physicians who have very little patience for wasted time

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of project management experience delivering software or SaaS implementations to external customers (internal IT projects alone won't be a fit)
- PMP certification required; if you're scheduled to sit for the exam within 6 months we'll consider you
- Bachelor's degree required
- Comfort with both waterfall-style milestone plans and Agile delivery - our engineering team runs two-week sprints and you need to speak that language
- Healthcare, health-tech, or EHR integration experience is a strong plus
- Experience with Jira, Smartsheet, or MS Project
- Excellent written communication - you'll send executive-facing status emails weekly and we will read your cover letter

Logistics
- Hybrid: 2 days/week in our Nashville office (Mondays and Wednesdays are team days); candidates must live within commuting distance or be willing to relocate
- Up to 15% travel to customer sites, concentrated around go-lives
- Salary range: $95,000 - $115,000 plus 10% annual bonus target
- Full benefits, 401(k) match, unlimited PTO with a 15-day minimum

BrightPath is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
text:
Executive Assistant to the CEO
Hollis & Crane Capital | New York, NY (Onsite, Midtown)

Hollis & Crane is a private investment firm with roughly $2.4B in assets under management and a team of 45. We are hiring an Executive Assistant to support our CEO and, secondarily, our CFO. This person sits at the center of the firm - nothing reaches the CEO's calendar, inbox, or desk without passing through you.

This is a fully onsite role, five days a week in our Midtown Manhattan office. The CEO is in the office when he's not traveling, and this role only works in person. Core hours are 8:00am-5:30pm with flexibility expected around board meetings and quarter-end.

Responsibilities
- Own a dense, constantly shifting calendar across multiple time zones; you'll make judgment calls daily about what gets bumped and what doesn't
- Book complex international travel (commercial and occasional private aviation), build detailed itineraries, and rebook on the fly when things break
- Prepare and submit expense reports for both executives in Concur
- Coordinate quarterly board meetings end to end: materials assembly, catering, AV, guest logistics
- Draft and proofread correspondence; manage the CEO's inbox triage during travel
- Handle highly confidential information - deal terms, personnel matters, LP communications - with total discretion
- Personal support amounting to roughly 10-15% of the role (family travel, occasional personal appointments)
- Back up the office manager on reception and vendor issues when needed

What we need
- Minimum 5 years of experience supporting C-suite executives; financial services, legal, or professional services background strongly preferred
- Bachelor's degree preferred but not required - we care far more about your track record
- Expert-level Outlook calendar management; proficiency with Concur and Zoom
- Unflappable under pressure and ruthlessly organized; you notice the double-booking before anyone else does
- Impeccable written communication - typos in your application materials will be noticed
- References from prior executives will be requested at the final stage

Compensation
- Base salary $95,000 - $120,000 depending on experience, plus discretionary bonus (recent years have ranged 10-20%)
- Fully paid medical/dental, 401(k) with match, 20 days PTO

Employment is contingent on a satisfactory background check, standard for our industry. Please apply with a resume and a brief note on the most complex logistical problem you've untangled for an executive.

title: Financial Analyst, FP&A
text:
Financial Analyst, FP&A
Redline Logistics Group | Dallas, TX (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)

Redline Logistics Group operates a fleet of 800 trucks and 12 distribution centers across the Southwest. Our FP&A team of five supports a $600M revenue business, and we're adding an analyst to take ownership of reporting and forecasting for our warehousing division.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain the monthly forecast and annual budget for the warehousing division (about $180M in revenue), working directly with two VPs of Operations
- Prepare monthly variance analysis comparing actuals to budget and forecast, with written commentary that goes to the CFO - "volume was down" is not commentary; we want to know why and what we're doing about it
- Develop and improve financial models for pricing decisions, facility expansions, and capital equipment purchases
- Own a set of weekly KPI dashboards in Power BI (labor cost per unit, throughput, overtime %) and keep the underlying data pipeline from our WMS clean
- Support the month-end close by reviewing accruals with the accounting team
- Ad hoc analysis - a lot of it. If the CFO wonders whether a customer is actually profitable, you'll find out

What we're looking for
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field - this is a firm requirement
- 2-4 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a related analytical role; logistics, transportation, or distribution industry experience is a plus but not required
- Advanced Excel: you should be comfortable building a three-statement or driver-based model from a blank workbook
- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar; SQL skills are a meaningful plus and will move you up the stack
- Familiarity with an EPM tool (we use Planful) or willingness to learn quickly
- Clear writing - half this job is explaining numbers to operators

Work authorization: candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on an ongoing basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas for this position now or in the future.

Location and schedule: hybrid from our Dallas headquarters (near Love Field) - Monday, Tuesday, Thursday onsite. This is not a remote-eligible position.

Compensation: $75,000 - $90,000 base depending on experience, plus a 7.5% target bonus. Benefits include medical/dental/vision, 401(k) with 5% match, and 18 days PTO.

Redline Logistics Group is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
